# VehicularMultiHopTopology

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A network architecture where vehicles form transient, multi-hop communication chains with rapidly changing connectivity patterns due to mobility. Serves as a stress-test topology for TCC research, exposing how routing and redundancy mechanisms must adapt to highly volatile link structures.
